mapper.select: SELECT student.id AS value, CONCAT(student.student_name, ' · ', student.student_number) AS label, CONCAT(COALESCE(major.major_name, '未设置专业'), ' · ', CASE student.gender WHEN 'M' THEN '男生' ELSE '女生' END) AS description FROM student LEFT JOIN major ON major.id=student.major_id WHERE #{keyword}<>'' AND ( student.student_number LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') OR student.student_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN student.student_number=#{keyword} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, student.student_number LIMIT 20

SELECT batch.id AS value, batch.batch_name AS label, CONCAT(batch.batch_status, ' · ', DATE_FORMAT(batch.start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i'), ' 至 ', DATE_FORMAT(batch.end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')) AS description FROM selection_batch batch WHERE batch.batch_status NOT IN ('CANCELLED') ORDER BY batch.created_at DESC, batch.id DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT major.id AS value, CONCAT(major.major_code, ' · ', major.major_name) AS label, CASE WHEN major.enabled=1 THEN '启用' ELSE '停用' END AS description FROM major ORDER BY major.enabled DESC, major.major_code

SELECT building.id AS value, CONCAT(building.building_code, ' · ', building.building_name) AS label, CASE WHEN building.enabled=1 THEN '正常开放' ELSE '已停用' END AS description FROM dormitory_building building ORDER BY building.enabled DESC, building.building_code
SELECT DISTINCT student.grade_year AS value, CONCAT(student.grade_year, '级') AS label, '按学生档案年级筛选' AS description FROM student WHERE student.grade_year IS NOT NULL ORDER BY student.grade_year DESC

SELECT DISTINCT student.degree_level AS value, CASE student.degree_level WHEN 'UNDERGRADUATE' THEN '本科生' WHEN 'MASTER' THEN '硕士研究生' WHEN 'DOCTOR' THEN '博士研究生' ELSE student.degree_level END AS label, '培养层次' AS description FROM student WHERE student.degree_level IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(student.degree_level)<>'' ORDER BY student.degree_level

SELECT DISTINCT student.student_category AS value, CASE student.student_category WHEN 'DOMESTIC' THEN '国内生' WHEN 'INTERNATIONAL' THEN '国际生' ELSE student.student_category END AS label, '学生类别' AS description FROM student WHERE student.student_category IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(student.student_category)<>'' ORDER BY student.student_category
